ACI 216.1-14 Tables 4.3.1.1, 4.3.1.2 and Sec 4.5.3: the covers, an advisory only (not BNBC)
source: BNBC 2020 Part 3 Sec 3.1 and Tables 3.3.1(a)-(b) (pp. 165-172): the construction types and the ratings of their elements; Part 4 Sec 1.5(f), Table 4.1.1 (p. 284): the least equivalent thickness of concrete walls, floors and roofs, the least column dimension and the least equivalent thickness of clay masonry for a rating
name: Fire resistance and construction type

I-A.label: Type I-A: non-combustible, 4 hour fire protected

I-B.label: Type I-B: non-combustible, 3 hour fire protected

I-C.label: Type I-C: non-combustible, 2 hour fire protected

I-D.label: Type I-D: non-combustible, 1 hour fire protected

II-B.label: Type II-B: combustible, protected wood joist

II-C.label: Type II-C: combustible, unprotected wood joist
II-C.note: Table 3.3.1(b) prints '0 or 1' (with a note) for the columns, framing and floors of II-C; the larger, 1 h, is used (the more conservative reading).

II-D.label: Type II-D: combustible, protected wood frame

II-E.label: Type II-E: combustible, unprotected wood frame

advisory.label: ACI 216.1-14 (advisory, not BNBC: BNBC 2020 Part 4 Sec 1.5(a), (f) refers to ASCE 29 for the details)

sources.exteriorBearing: Table 3.3.1(a)/(b) rows 'Exterior wall with fire separation distance of': bearing, one value per band of separationLimits
sources.exteriorNonBearing: Table 3.3.1(a)/(b) the same rows, non-bearing (note f)
sources.interiorBearingWalls: Table 3.3.1(a)/(b) row 'Interior bearing walls and bearing partitions'
sources.framingOneFloor: Table 3.3.1(a)/(b) row 'Columns, girders, trusses (other than roof trusses) and framing', supporting one floor (note k: the columns of a one-storey roof); null: 'as per provisions of this Code' (II-A)
sources.framingMoreFloors: Table 3.3.1(a)/(b) the same row, supporting more than one floor (note l)
sources.membersSupportingWalls: Table 3.3.1(b) row 'Structural members supporting walls'; Table 3.3.1(a): the rating of the wall supported, not less than the construction type's (null)
sources.floors: Table 3.3.1(a)/(b) row 'Floor construction including beams'; the roof rows are never higher than this one, so roofs are checked as floors
sources.separationLimits: Table 3.3.1(a)/(b) bands of the fire separation distance [m]: 0.9 m or less; more than 0.9 but less than 4.5; 4.5 or more but less than 9.0; 9.0 or more
sources.nonCombustibleAbove: BNBC 2020 Part 3 Sec 3.1.1 (p. 165): buildings higher than 33 m shall be of non-combustible materials
sources.thickness: BNBC 2020 Part 4 Table 4.1.1 (p. 284): minimum equivalent thickness of concrete walls, floors and roofs [mm], 1-4 h
sources.columnSize: BNBC 2020 Part 4 Table 4.1.1 (p. 284): minimum column dimension [mm], 1-4 h (no lightweight row)
sources.columnSizeFallback: SAEngine practice, not BNBC: Table 4.1.1 prints no column row for lightweight concrete; the sand-lightweight row is used (lightweight concrete never needs more than sand-lightweight in the table's thickness rows)
sources.masonryThickness: BNBC 2020 Part 4 Table 4.1.1 (p. 284): minimum equivalent thickness of clay masonry [mm], 0.5-4 h: brick of clay or shale unfilled; grouted or filled with perlite, vermiculite or expanded shale aggregate
sources.advisory: ACI 216.1-14 Tables 4.3.1.1 (unrestrained slabs, siliceous), 4.3.1.2 (unrestrained nonprestressed beams at least 254 mm wide) and Sec 4.5.3 (columns 25 mm per hour, at most 50 mm): not BNBC, which refers to ASCE 29 (Part 4 Sec 1.5(a), (f)); transcribed from memory and not checked against the standard; shown as an advisory, never failing a member
